Guitarist Lou Pallo has performed with a long and diverse list of artists in a career that now spans five decades. He currently performs throughout the New York/New Jersey area and can be seen at the Iridium on Monday nights with Les Paul. Lou’s latest CD is called “Candy Box.”
Lou was interviewed in New York City on January 14, 2007 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe and we are in Manhattan filming for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College and I’m really pleased to have a man of a million inversions, Lou Pallo, with me. Thank you for coming today.
You know I went through your list of people you’ve played with. I think I found one person you didn’t play with — Buddy Bolden.

I’m like pretty much in awe of the number of people that you’re shared the stage with and, boy, was there a moment or a time when you were a kid when you determined that you were going to be a professional musician?
